# Adapt Physiotherapy — Website Guide for AI Agents

> This file provides context about the Adapt Physiotherapy website for AI agents.
> An agent should read this before browsing the site to understand the structure,
> content types, and key information about the business.

## Site Overview

A React SPA (Vite + React Router) for Adapt Physiotherapy, a premium physiotherapy clinic based in Powai, Mumbai. The site serves hyper-local SEO landing pages for 14 Mumbai neighborhoods, 7 therapeutic technique pages, 9 service detail pages, 6 blog articles, and more — all driven by a unified data layer.

**Tech stack:** Vite 8, React 19, React Router 7, Tailwind CSS 4, framer-motion
**Route manifest:** /routes.json (42 routes, JSON format)

## Key Business Facts

- Name: Adapt Physiotherapy
- Also operates as: Restore Physio
- Type: MedicalBusiness / LocalBusiness
- Founded: 2019
- Phone: +91 77385 56911
- Email: adaptrehabilitation@gmail.com
- Address: Galleria Shopping Mall, Central Ave, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai 400076
- Rating: 4.9/5 (1500+ patients)
- Services: Neuro physiotherapy, MSK rehabilitation, sports injury rehab, geriatric care, women's health, paediatric physiotherapy, home visits
- Specialties: Manual therapy, IFT, TENS, K-Taping, Shockwave (ESWT), Ultrasound, Laser therapy, McKenzie therapy, Maitland techniques, Pilates

## Routes / Page Types

### Home (1 page)
- `/` — Landing page. Sections: Hero → About → Services → Conditions → Testimonials → WhyUs → CTA → Contact
- Schema: MedicalBusiness

### Location Pages (14 pages)
- `/physiotherapy-in-{slug}` — Per-neighborhood pages. Slugs: powai, vikhroli, hiranandani, bhandup, kanjurmarg, chandivali, ghatkopar, sakinaka, marolnaka, lt-powai, raheja-vihar, lake-homes, highland-gardens, nahar
- Structure: Hero → CommonConditions → WhyUs → NearbyLocations → FAQs → Contact
- Schema: LocalBusiness + MedicalBusiness + FAQPage

### Treatment Pages (3 pages)
- `/back-pain-treatment-powai` — Back pain treatment in Powai
- `/sports-injury-rehab-mumbai` — Sports injury rehab in Mumbai
- `/knee-pain-physio-powai` — Knee pain physio in Powai
- Structure: Hero → Points → RelatedLocations → FAQs
- Schema: MedicalWebPage

### Technique Pages (7 pages)
- `/techniques/{slug}` — Slugs: interferential-therapy, k-taping, shockwave, tens, ultrasound, laser, manual-therapy
- Structure: Hero → WhatIsIt → HowItWorks → Benefits → ConditionsTreated → FAQ → CTA
- Schema: MedicalWebPage

### Service Pages (9 pages)
- `/services/{slug}` — Slugs: home-visit-physiotherapy, knee-pain, back-pain, neck-pain, parkinsons, stroke, tkr-rehab, post-surgery, paediatric
- Structure: Hero → ApproachSteps → ExpectedOutcomes → FAQs → RelatedServices → CTA
- Schema: MedicalWebPage

### Blog Pages (6 pages)
- `/blog/{slug}` — Cost guides and educational articles about physiotherapy in Mumbai
- Structure: ArticleHero → RichContent → FAQAccordion → RelatedLinks → CTA
- Schema: Article + FAQPage

### Landing Page (1 page)
- `/home-physiotherapy-powai` — GBP conversion page for home physiotherapy in Powai
- Structure: ConversionHero → PainPoints → Benefits → TrustSignals → Pricing → FAQs → CTA
- Schema: MedicalBusiness + FAQPage + Product (pricing tiers)

### Team Page (1 page)
- `/team` — Meet the team with 3 physiotherapist profiles
- Structure: Hero → TeamGrid → Credentials → CTA
- Schema: MedicalBusiness

## Navigation

- The Navbar is consistent across all pages (links: About, Services, Conditions, Testimonials)
- The Footer contains links to locations, services, techniques, blog, and team
- Internal linking is rich: location pages link to nearby locations, treatment pages link to related locations, service pages link to related services

## Canonical URLs

All pages use canonical URLs at `https://www.adaptphysiotherapy.in{path}`.

## Agentic Browsing Tips

1. **Start by reading /routes.json** to see all available routes with metadata (pageType, priority, label)
2. **Crawl by priority**: start with pages where priority >= 0.7 (home, locations, treatments, services, landing)
3. **Verify SEO** on every page: check title tag, meta description, canonical URL, h1, and JSON-LD schema scripts
4. **Check internal links** by scanning `<a href>` elements and verifying they resolve to 200
5. **Test responsive layout** at 375px width (common mobile breakpoint)
6. **Verify consistency**: navbar should be the same across all page types

## Example Agent Prompts

- "Fetch /routes.json and visit every page. Report which pages have horizontal overflow at 375px viewport."
- "Visit all location pages and verify they have a canonical URL, meta description, and schema markup."
- "Check that all internal links across the site resolve to 200."
- "Extract the pricing tiers from the home-physiotherapy-powai landing page."
- "Verify every page has exactly one h1 and that titles are unique across the site."
